core_principles: Color is Function Only: 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.
Density & Data Correlation: Every pixel must be utilized. Use the Control Room grid.
Expose the Skeleton: Use the 'Grid Borders' surface strategy. Sharp lines, no soft shadows.
Developer-Grade: Use monospace fonts for all data points, IPs, selectors, and logs.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense data, tables, and forms. Center-align empty states.

surface_strategies.global: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Containers use 1px solid borders (border-border). No drop shadows.
surface_strategies.cards_and_widgets: Flat background, 1px subtle border. On hover, slight border color darken, no lift.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border. No glassmorphism. Must have visible navigation on desktop.
surface_strategies.logs_panel: Terminal variant: Contrast shift. Dark background (#0A0A0A) inside the light app, with monospace green/white text for logs.

components_strategy.tables: Shadcn tables. Dense spacing (py-2), sticky headers, monospace for specific data columns (IP, proxy, selectors).
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn forms, Input, Select, Checkbox. 1px borders, square corners.
components_strategy.buttons: Square corners. Primary CTA uses primary color. Hover state must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-blue-800 hover:text-white). Limit primary color usage to major actions only.
components_strategy.badges: Square borders. Signal colors for status (Green=Running/Done, Red=Failed, Yellow=Retrying/Captcha).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have higher contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary).

icons.instructions: Use for dense dashboards. Install via `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`

images.description: Dark blue abstract geometric vertical lines, use as a background for login screen or abstract data visualizations.

media.rules: No placeholder images. Use provided URLs.

testing.rules: All interactive elements must have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout with 'Grid Borders' strategy. Do not rely heavily on pre-built structural components if they enforce soft shadows or large radii.
Apply Shadcn UI components for all interactive elements (Tables, Forms, Dialogs) but override rounded corners to `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm`.
Ensure the Logs Viewer component uses a dark theme (bg-black text-white/green font-mono) to contrast with the light dashboard.
Do not use space grotesk or inter for headings. Use IBM Plex Sans.
Do not use gradients. Stick to flat, high-contrast colors.
Limit the use of the primary color strictly to the most critical CTAs.
Every page MUST have a visible navigation bar on desktop.
Apply the styling to .js/.jsx files (not .tsx) as the project uses JavaScript.
